content: Official OSM tile policy requires visible attribution, valid referer/user agent behavior, HTTP caching, and forbids bulk scraping or prefetch. OGC WCS models raster coverages with GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, GetCoverage, coverage envelopes and CRS/axis metadata. For this demo bbox and pixel dimensions must be bounded before WCS retrieval, CRS and axis order made explicit, and upstream usage constraints surfaced honestly.
